description: Renames a Sitecore item over the Authoring and Management API. The item keeps its ID, so links to it survive, but its path changes and any URL derived from the name changes with it. Supply exactly one of id or path.

database.description: The database holding the item. Defaults to master.

id.description: The item's GUID. Supply this or path.

newName.description: The new name. Sitecore rejects names containing / \ : ? " < > | [ ].

path.description: The item's full path. Supply this or id.

name: authoring-rename-item
